## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `AnomalyDetectionAndAlerts`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `anomaly-detection-alerts`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **AnomalyDetectionAndAlerts**.

## Step 2: Configure an alert

1. <!-- manual: Open the integration you want to monitor. -->
2. In the left navigation under **Observability**, select **Alerts**.
3. Select **Create Alert Rule**.
4. Select **Alert Type**.
5. Select **Environment** to monitor.
6. Select **Deployment Track** or **Version** as required.
7. <!-- manual: Select the Deployment Track or Version as required. -->
8. <!-- manual: Configure the parameters specific to the selected alert type. -->
9. <!-- manual: In the Emails field, enter the email addresses to notify when the alert triggers. :::note -->
10. - Press **Enter** after typing each email address to add it.
11. <!-- manual: You can add a maximum of 5 email addresses per alert. -->
12. Select **Advanced Configurations**.
13. <!-- manual: Expand Advanced Configurations to set additional parameters if needed. Available options vary by alert type. -->
14. Review the **Explanation** callout to confirm the alert is configured as intended.
15. Select **Create** to save and activate the alert rule. :::info You can configure a maximum of 10 alerts per integration. :::
